glosses: A melodic theme associated with a particular character, place, thing or idea in an opera.

examples.text: In Wagner's operas, especially his cycle of four operas known collectively as the Ring cycle, the leitmotif did not simply label or point to one particular character or object but rather conjured up a realm of ideas.

glosses: A recurring theme.
